Anya (PM): Quick check — PRD draft for 'Monitoring Gridlock' (console-side observability) attached. Goal: define launch criteria and tricky edge cases customers hit when retention + rollups interact with trace sampling.

Mike (Eng): Thanks. Quick ask: can we pin the perf SLOs in the PRD? latency at p95 for dashboard load etc.

Anya (PM): Yes — draft has SLOs but flesh out p50/p95. Also need failure modes: 1) retention cleanup runs during query peak 2) rollup lag showing stale charts 3) UX-loading spinner loops.

Emily (UX): Noted — I'll add microcopy for the 'stale data' state and a clear CTA for 'Refresh' + indicator when data is incomplete.

Josiah (SRE): Important edge: customers with large retention and high-cardinality tags see query timeouts. Propose: circuit-breaker that returns partial results + warning. Also include a fast-fail path: if scan > 10s, return partial.

Rahul (Data): For rollups: we should add acceptance criteria around aggregation correctness: +/- 0.5% for counts, timestamp alignment within 1min. Also log when buckets are dropped.

deploy-bot: canary deploy scheduled: prod-canary-2026-03-22T18:00Z :rocket: 

Anya (PM): Draft acceptance criteria (pls comment inline):
```
1) Dashboard load p95 <= 800ms on 95% of traffic in dedicated tier
2) When retention compaction runs, client queries must not exceed 2x baseline latency
3) Circuit-breaker: if scan latency > 10s, return partial response with error code 429-partial and UX banner
4) Rollup correctness: totals within 0.5% of raw for 1h windows, and timestamps aligned to nearest minute
5) UX: explicit 'stale data' state and 'refresh' CTA; spinner shows <5s typical
6) Logging: every partial/fast-fail must generate a trace/span with tag rollout=true
```

Mike (Eng): Q on #2: '2x baseline' is vague — baseline = median of last 24h? propose baseline = median p95 over last 7d. Also need a load profile to test autoscaling.

Anya (PM): agree. update: baseline = median p95 over trailing 7d. We'll attach load generator profile (see link) and a small sample JMeter script.

Emily (UX): Edge cases for UX flows: - empty-time-range after retention purge; - overlapping rollup buckets causing duplicate datapoints in chart; - in-chart tooltip must show 'last raw sample' vs 'rolled up'.

Josiah (SRE): Operational acceptance: - graceful fallback to lower-fidelity rollup (config flag) - alert if partial-responses rate > 0.1% over 5m - playbook for manual rollback.

Rahul (Data): Test data: we'll create synthetic tenants with high-cardinality labels and 30d retention. I can seed two tenants that mimic customer A/B that triggered the bug.

Anya (PM): OK next steps: Mike + Josiah iterate implementation plan, Emily mockups for stale/partial states, Rahul seeds test tenants, I will update PRD with these acceptance criteria and share RFC link. Ping me by EOD Wed with blockers.

Mike (Eng): On it. I'll drop a short task list in the RFC.

Josiah (SRE): I'll add the alert rules and rollback playbook draft.

Anya (PM): thanks team :white_check_mark:
